prompt: Species: slime-girl predator that is bad at keeping a human shape. Her whole body is translucent soda-blue jelly with a glossy highlight; inside her body you can clearly see things she swallowed floating: a candy, a brass key, a button, a small bottle cap. Her hair is the same jelly, bob-length, drooping and dripping at the ends. Her feet are melting into a small puddle on the floor. Eyes: half-lidded deadpan 'jito-me' look, pale cyan irises with white highlights, faint darker under-eye shadows. Small sharp shark-like jagged teeth visible in a tiny open mouth. Wears an oversized pale yellow raincoat with the hood down, sleeves too long. Holding a half-eaten donut, caught red-handed, looking away guiltily. Background: simple kitchen at night.

Species: devouring species with a second mouth that speaks her true feelings. A gentle nun in a black and white habit with a short veil; long silver hair in a loose braid. Eyes: black sclera with bright gold irises, kind droopy eyes, soft smile. On the back of her neck, partially visible beneath the lifted veil as she turns her head, there is a second mouth with jagged teeth and a long tongue, grinning mischievously and drooling a little. Faint black crack-like markings at the corners of her lips. She is holding a rosary in one hand and a fork and knife in the other, palms pressed together as if saying grace before a meal. Background: candle-lit chapel dining hall.

Species: spider-type predator, introverted hacker. Six eyes: two large main eyes plus four small eyes in a row on her forehead, all deep crimson, all with heavy dark under-eye bags, sleepy deadpan expression. Messy long black hair with white streaks and an ahoge. Pale skin. Four arms: two normal arms and two extra slender arms coming out from her oversized charcoal hoodie; one hand holds a game controller, one holds an energy drink, one types on a laptop, one holds a snack bag. Silk threads connect cables around her like a web. Wears hoodie with a small spider emblem, shorts, black tights with web pattern, fluffy slippers. Small fangs. Background: dark messy room lit by monitors, web of cables.

Species: deep-sea frilled-shark girl, an ancient predator who is clingy and affectionate. Long eel-like dark brown-gray hair, sleek. A large frilly ruff collar around her neck that is actually her six pairs of pink-red gill frills, like an Elizabethan lace collar. Eyes: big round emerald-green eyes with a glossy shine, puppy-dog adoring look. Her open smiling mouth shows rows of many tiny trident-shaped sharp teeth. A long dark eel-like tail with a fin coming out from under her skirt, wagging happily. Skin pale with faint shark-skin texture on the cheeks and forearms. Wears a cute navy sailor-style dress with frills. Hugging a large fish plush toy. Background: dim deep sea with faint light from above.

Species: high-strangeness 'object-head' type. Her head is a large translucent glowing jellyfish bell instead of a human head, softly pink and lavender; inside the bell a cute simple face is faintly visible made of bioluminescent glowing dots (two dot eyes and a small smile), and long thin glowing tentacles hang from the rim of the bell like long hair down to her knees. The body below is a normal elegant human girl's body. Wears a white and lavender frilled lolita-style dress resembling jellyfish layers, white gloves, holding a small parasol. Graceful curtsy pose. Background: dark aquarium room with floating particles and blue light.

Species: chimera girl that grows the body parts of the beasts she has eaten. Expressionless, stoic, deadpan face, but her animal parts betray her emotions: a mismatched pair of ears, left ear is a fluffy fox ear standing straight up excitedly, right ear is a droopy rabbit ear; behind her a scaly dragon tail and a fluffy wolf tail both wagging. One forearm covered in tiger-striped fur with claws. Short ash-blonde hair with a single orange streak. Eyes: amber with slit pupils, flat bored look, a small blush on her cheeks contradicting her expression. Wears a simple hunter outfit: dark green cape, leather vest, belt pouches. Holding a meat skewer. Background: forest campsite at dusk.

Species: symbiotic duo, a gentle host girl and a parasitic organism living in her hair. The girl has soft cream-colored long hair, droopy kind lavender eyes and a calm gentle smile. Part of her hair, one large twin-tail on her right side, is a living black and deep red organic parasite with its own big expressive single eye and a jagged toothy mouth, making a grumpy tsundere angry face, shaped like a cute little monster. Faint red vein-like markings near her right temple where the parasite connects. Wears a soft cardigan over a long skirt, a satchel bag. The girl is offering a cookie to the parasite, which is refusing while clearly wanting it. Background: cozy cafe.

Species: predator disguised as an angel. At first glance she looks holy and beautiful: long wavy platinum-blonde hair, a white and gold robe, a glowing golden halo, large white feathered wings. But looking closer, the halo is made of rings of small sharp teeth, and the feathers at the edges of her wings end in small eyes and tiny mouths. Eyes: black sclera with glowing white irises, serene gentle smile. Pale skin with faint golden vein markings on her hands. Hands clasped in prayer. Gap between holy appearance and eldritch details. Background: ruined cathedral with stained glass light.
